title: malva sylvestris var. polymorpha
intro: Malva sylvestris var. polymorpha, commonly known as Mallow, is a plant species that belongs to the family Malvaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Mallow, such as flavonoids, saponins, and mucilages, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, soothing digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems. Additionally, Mallow has been traditionally used to treat a range of health conditions, including skin irritations, fever, and coughs, due to its anti-inflammatory and soothing properties.
